verdict.rationale: The evidence points to official building blocks for developers: framework integrations for LangChain, LlamaIndex, Vercel AI SDK and Genkit, step-by-step quickstarts per application type, and a community comment that Auth0's open-source packages are well maintained. No item explicitly names or describes an official SDK catalog, its languages, or its API coverage, and the claim that integration takes just a few lines of code is thin. missing for 10: explicit first-party SDK documentation (language and framework list, reference docs), evidence of Management/Authentication API SDK coverage, hands-on corroboration of SDK quality.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can build against official SDKs
